description: Store a secret (encrypted at rest) in the vault. Returns key confirmation, NEVER the value. Use rotate() to update existing secrets.
embedding_description: Vault: store a secret. Encrypt and persist a value (password, API key, credential, OAuth client_secret, refresh token, bearer token) under a named vault key using AES-256-GCM at rest. Returns the key and version; NEVER the secret value. Variants that keep the plaintext out of the agent's conversation context: store_from_env, store_from_file, store_from_keychain, store_from_kv_file, store_random.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that secret was encrypted and stored. Contains key (identifier) and message (status). NEVER contains the secret value.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Encrypts and stores a secret value in the vault. Uses AES-256-GCM encryption with unique salt and nonce per secret.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: VaultLocked: Vault must be unlocked before storing secrets. KeyExists: Secret already exists - use rotate() to update. InvalidKey: Key contains invalid characters or format.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For VaultLocked: Prompt user to unlock vault first. For KeyExists: Ask if user wants to rotate the existing secret. For InvalidKey: Suggest valid key format (alphanumeric, slashes, underscores).
